audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributes the blind to Quinn's E (Vault) in 'early' and wants.foe[0].
audit.why: Riot's text: Vault dashes to the target, damages, slows, briefly interrupts, and leaps her back to attack range — no blind. The vision hinder/blind is on Blinding Assault (Q), an 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s ability. Vault itself is 12/11/10/9/8s and, as an immobilising effect, is what Riposte converts into a stun.
audit.corrected: Blind reattributed to Q in 'early' and wants.foe[0]; both cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet counted 1 sequencing cue; Vault was named with no duration.
audit.why: 12s at rank 1 is the whole all-in window on a champion whose only escape it is.

edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5/10. The lane is decided by whether you parry her 12s Vault or chase her without it.

edits.before: His early — survive to your spikes. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.

edits.before: - Quinn Vault: matchup-defining — Her self-peel. Out-duel when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Vault: 12s at rank 1 — her only escape, and parrying it returns a stun. Commit the moment it is spent. - Blinding Assault: 11s, and the blind is on her Q, not her E — do not auto into the blind; Lunge after it.

edits.before: Land E vault to knock you off and blind your Bladework crit, then Harrier-kite to safety
edits.after: Land E vault to knock you off your Bladework crit, then Q-blind and Harrier-kite to safety

edits.before: Quinn's whole early game is the E vault — it knocks you back and blinds your next auto, so never throw your Bladework crit into a held E. Bait it: walk up with the caster minions between you so she can't land a clean vault, eat the blind on a normal auto, then Lunge in and proc your Vital. Her Harrier passive lets her kite, but at Levels 2-3 the slow from Bladework's first auto pins her long enough to guarantee the crit on the second.
edits.after: Quinn's whole early game is the E vault — it knocks you back and briefly interrupts you, so never throw your Bladework crit into a held E. Bait it: walk up with the caster minions between you so she can't land a clean vault, eat her Q blind on a normal auto, then Lunge in and proc your Vital. Her Harrier passive lets her kite, but at Levels 2-3 the slow from Bladework's first auto pins her long enough to guarantee the crit on the second.

notes: Quinn's R (Behind Enemy Lines) is listed with a 3s cooldown because that is the recast timer, not a real ultimate cooldown — I deliberately did not put that number on the page, since printing '3s ult' would mislead.
